name: The Happy Prince
source: A mysterious entity said to be the most powerful of all "strangenesses" (怪异) and which is in some way in charge of "strangenesses" not controlled by the Agency (商号). A person that desires the power of the "strangenesses" can enter into a contract with them.
translation: A mysterious entity said to be the most powerful of all "strangenesses" (怪异) and which is in some way in charge of "strangenesses" not controlled by the Agency (商号). A person that desires the power of the "strangenesses" can enter into a contract with them.
